seoTitle: How to Create a MySQL Database in Hostinger
metaDescription: Create a MySQL database in Hostinger, assign a user, and access phpMyAdmin to manage tables and run SQL queries for your site or app.
intro: Whether you're setting up WordPress or building a custom application, most projects eventually need a MySQL database, and Hostinger makes creating one fairly quick. This guide covers setting up a new database, assigning a user, and logging into phpMyAdmin to manage your data.

steps.heading: Open the database section in Hostinger
steps.body: Go to your hosting dashboard and find the tool for creating a new MySQL database.

steps.heading: Create the database and assign a user
steps.body: Set up your new database and create a user with the correct permissions to connect to it.

steps.heading: Connect it to your website or app
steps.body: Use the database credentials to link your new database with your WordPress site or custom application.

steps.heading: Log in to phpMyAdmin
steps.body: Access phpMyAdmin securely to manage tables, import or export data, and run SQL queries as needed.

faq.question: Do I need to create a user separately from the database?
faq.answer: Yes, you create the database and then assign a user with permissions so it can be accessed by your site or app.

faq.question: Can I import and export data in phpMyAdmin?
faq.answer: Yes, phpMyAdmin lets you import and export data along with running SQL queries directly.

faq.question: Is this suitable for WordPress users?
faq.answer: Yes, it's helpful for both beginners working on WordPress and developers building custom sites.

faq.question: How do I access phpMyAdmin securely?
faq.answer: You log in through the credentials tied to your database from within your Hostinger control panel.
